facts.fact: The National Treasury's draft National Payment System Policy of August 2026 says the Central Bank of Kenya migrated government payments to its real-time gross settlement system and rolled out internet banking for ministries, departments and agencies and for county governments; it gives no date, no count of counties and nothing on how county offices are connected, so the date here is the document's published date.
facts.system: County governments' use of Central Bank of Kenya internet banking

systems.system: Central Bank of Kenya internet banking for government
systems.tiers: ministries, departments and agencies, and county governments
